title: Bugrock Instant Bartering
description: Add a bedrock bug (feature) where making piglins angry by opening their chests or destroy a gold block instantly finish their trade.
body:
Make piglin with any current trade instantly finish when you open a chest, destroy a gold block in 16 radius, and 8 radius for moving gold block with piston.

I havent test on other version but you can do, im just too lazy bc i make this for my survival world

You can just freely use it or port it to older or newer version whatever, i dont care just credit me.
